review_scope: Independent review of the entire one-key Taiwan Sixian Hakka Pha̍k-fa-sṳ sentence against English meaning, its paired Han text, primary lexical readings, and primary PFS usage. No source edits or external writes.
source_text: Android chhìm m̀ cho̍k tóng-on kién-hi. Chhiáng chhai Android sat-thin tú khí-yung “Files” ia-he “vùn-khien” chhàng-sṳt, ko chhṳ khon.
recommended_full_text: Android chhìm m̀ tó tóng-on kién-hi. Chhiáng chhai Android sat-thin tú khí-yung “Files” ya-he “vùn-khien” chhàng-sṳt, ko chhṳ khon.

decision: The recommended complete sentence is acceptable in this bounded, evidence-based review. Required correction: cho̍k to tó in failed finding. Also recommend ia-he to ya-he as modern PFS orthographic normalization, without claiming a second pronunciation defect. No other concrete defect established after the complete term-by-term and semantic review.

required_finding.reason: MOE/NAER Four-County textbook explicitly gives 尋毋著 as qimˇ mˇ doˋ, meaning unable to find. The result complement is do31, represented by PFS tó. cho̍k is not the do31 result-complement reading required here; the NCU source distinguishes 著’s other contextual readings. Han 尋毋著 remains correct.

orthographic_recommendation.classification: Preferred modern PFS spelling / normalization, not separately proven semantic or pronunciation defect.
orthographic_recommendation.reason: Official Hakka spelling ia55 he55 denotes the right pronunciation. Primary PFS usage writes ya-he, including bilingual 抑係 examples in the 2012 Bible as studied by original linguistic research. Do not mechanically copy the official phonetic system into PFS. However, a research bibliography also records the PFS title Ia-ha̍p; without an authoritative exclusion rule this review does not claim all initial ia spellings invalid.

term_checks.finding: Correct negative finding result; see required finding.
檔案 includes computer data/program records in MOE definition; correct digital-file sense and PFS tones.
揀 select + 器 tool/device forms transparent file-picker terminology. Pronunciation supported; compound not claimed to be a separately dictionary-attested Hakka technical term.
Polite request marker 請, suitable UI register.
Written locative 在 ... 肚 means in/inside; appropriate for in Android settings. Other colloquial 在 readings exist but do not invalidate chhai.
設定 appropriate technical noun. sat is correct, not set. Aspirated tin becomes PFS thin.
啟用 carries enable/activate meaning, rather than merely open. PFS khí and yung match the checked readings.

Alternatives, not a requirement to enable both. vùn-khien is correct North-Sixian 文件; South-Sixian kian is not the selected form. Literal app label is translated on one side only; retaining Documents in English could aid recognition, but no evidence here proves the existing localized label wrong.
程式 means program/app in this technical context; PFS aspirated chh, grave tone, central vowel ṳ, and checked final t are correct.
過 = again, 試看 = try. Correct retry instruction; following the enable clause naturally supplies the sequence then. No added tense or classifier required.

semantic_and_register_review: All source clauses retained: Android cannot find a picker, enable either named app in Android settings, then retry. Clear polite UI language with standard technical nouns and Hakka locative/retry construction. No requirement to enable both, create a file, or grant extra permissions has been introduced. No definite grammatical or tone defect beyond the contextual 著 reading was established.
limitations: Evidence-based translation review, not native-speaker certification or user comprehension testing.
Sources chiefly give official Hakka Romanization Scheme readings; PFS conversion is analytical, checked against original PFS usage, not a claim that MOE directly publishes this full UI sentence.
Coined software compound kién-hi is compositionally defensible but not directly attested as a dictionary headword.
No claim about actual device-specific Files/Documents labels or Android package behavior; this review covers language only.
No other keys, catalogue, prior withdrawn review results, runtime rendering, fonts or full acceptance receipts are certified.
